input.quote: ARTICLE XII INDEMNITY Licensee will be solely responsible for any commercial or legal liability that may arise as a result of Licensee's exercise of any of the license rights granted by Licensor to Licensee under this Agreement, and Licensee shall defend, indemnify, and hold Licensor harmless from and against any and all suits, claims, proceedings, judgments, awards, damages, loss, liability, cost and expenses
input.rationale: Article XII is a one-way Licensee indemnity in the Licensor's favour, and there is no Licensor indemnity anywhere in the Agreement; Article XIII goes further and states that "UNDER NO CIRCUMSTANCE SHALL LICENSOR BE LIABLE" for third-party infringement claims arising from use of the Licensed Technology. That is walk-away territory under this rule (no Vendor IP indemnity at all, one-way Customer indemnity). We therefore added a Licensor IP indemnity at the fallback level - customary Licensee modification, combination and specification exclusions, procure/modify/replace and refund remedies, and a super-cap of three times annual fees - and conformed the Article XIII infringement disclaimer and liability cap so the new indemnity is not negated. We left the existing Licensee indemnity in place rather than pursuing the preferred position, which would require broader collateral rewrites.

proposal.summary: Add Licensor IP indemnity with customary exclusions, procure/modify/replace/refund remedies and a 3x annual fees super-cap, and conform Article XIII so it does not negate that indemnity.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article XII runs only in Licensor's favour and Article XIII expressly disclaims any Licensor liability for infringement claims, so we have added a Licensor IP indemnity at our fallback position (customary Licensee modification, combination and specification exclusions, procure/modify/replace and refund remedies, capped at three times annual fees) and carved that indemnity out of the Article XIII infringement disclaimer and liability cap so it is operative.

ops.text: ARTICLE XII-A LICENSOR IP INDEMNITY Licensor shall indemnify Licensee against any third-party claim that the Licensed Technology infringes or misappropriates such third party's intellectual property rights, except to the extent the claim arises from (i) modifications to the Licensed Technology made by Licensee, (ii) combination of the Licensed Technology with items not supplied by Licensor, or (iii) Licensee's specifications. Licensor shall, at its option, procure for Licensee the right to continue using, or modify or replace, the affected Licensed Technology, and if none of those remedies is reasonably available, Licensor shall refund the fees paid by Licensee for the affected Licensed Technology. Licensor's aggregate liability under this Article XII-A shall not exceed three (3) times the annual fees paid by Licensee to Licensor under this Agreement.

ops.oldText: UNDER NO CIRCUMSTANCE SHALL LICENSOR BE LIABLE FOR ANY ACTIONS, CLAIMS OR THE LIKE BY LICENSEE OR ANY THIRD PARTY THAT THE USE OF THE LICENSED TECHNOLOGY HAS RESULTED, RESULTS OR MAY RESULT IN ANY INFRINGEMENT, DEPRIVATION OR VIOLATION OF THE INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY, CONSTITUTIONAL, STATUTORY, CONTRACTUAL, COMMON LAW OR OTHER RIGHTS OF ANY PERSON (b) IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED ONE HALF OF THE AMOUNT PAID BY THE LICENSEE TO Licensor HEREUNDER.
ops.newText: EXCEPT FOR LICENSOR'S INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS UNDER ARTICLE XII-A, UNDER NO CIRCUMSTANCE SHALL LICENSOR BE LIABLE FOR ANY ACTIONS, CLAIMS OR THE LIKE BY LICENSEE OR ANY THIRD PARTY THAT THE USE OF THE LICENSED TECHNOLOGY HAS RESULTED, RESULTS OR MAY RESULT IN ANY INFRINGEMENT, DEPRIVATION OR VIOLATION OF THE INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY, CONSTITUTIONAL, STATUTORY, CONTRACTUAL, COMMON LAW OR OTHER RIGHTS OF ANY PERSON (b) EXCEPT FOR LICENSOR'S INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS UNDER ARTICLE XII-A, IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED ONE HALF OF THE AMOUNT PAID BY THE LICENSEE TO Licensor HEREUNDER.

mappings.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer against third-party intellectual-property claims.
The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer modifications.
The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer combinations.
The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer specifications.
Vendor must procure continued use, modify, or replace the infringing item.
Vendor must refund applicable fees if procure, modify, or replace remedies are unavailable.
Vendor's indemnity is subject to a super-cap of three times annual fees.
